title: Commercial EV Charging Hardware (EVSE)
seo_title: Commercial EV Charging Hardware Manufacturers & DC Fast Chargers
description: Commercial electric vehicle charging hardware (EVSE) provides the mission-critical high-voltage infrastructure required to power electric delivery vans, transit buses, municipal fleets, and Class 8 heavy-duty freight trucks. Unlike residential Level 2 chargers, commercial fleet hardware demands industrial-grade durability, continuous thermal management, and adherence to open communication standards like OCPP 1.6J and OCPP 2.0.1. Depot hardware solutions span high-power DC fast chargers (50kW to 400kW), liquid-cooled satellite dispensers, and emerging Megawatt Charging System (MCS) architectures designed for rapid turnaround. Top hardware manufacturers prioritize modular power cabinets with dynamic internal power routing, enabling depots to dynamically distribute kilowatt capacity across multiple charging cables based on real-time vehicle demand. By pairing robust physical enclosures, liquid-cooled cabling, and ISO 15118 Plug & Charge capabilities with open protocols, enterprise fleet operators maintain multi-vendor flexibility and protect capital investments against hardware obsolescence.
